capabilities: Insert verses from typed references (e.g. Jean 3:16) via Tab or a command
Read offline Bible translations, interlinear text, CCDB search, hymns and pericope in a library reader
Collect and group a note's Bible references and append selected texts to a sermon
Open cross-references (TSK) and linked study notes from clicked references
Follow daily readings: verse of the day, Teny Fiainana MP3s and a 90-day plan
extras: Bible corpora, audio tracks and OCR models are downloaded as an offline data pack from GitHub releases; third-party component licenses and provenance notes ship with each release; the plugin states it collects no telemetry. Some content (MDG, FFPM, Teny Fiainana) targets French- and Malagasy-speaking users.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up Bible passages or insert verse text from references, so readers and preachers must leave the vault or paste verses manually.

summary: Local Bible study plugin that inserts scripture references as Markdown, reads multiple Bible translations offline, and supports sermon preparation.
